Task T3 is complete. Summary:

- **Script**: `out/T3/solution.py` — loads the OLMo-1B state dict from the sharded input, casts exactly the 112 per-layer projection matrices (q/k/v/o_proj, gate/up/down_proj) to bfloat16 via an anchored, dot-escaped regex, leaves `embed_tokens.weight` and `lm_head.weight` in float32, then bin-packs tensors into shards under the 256 MiB tensor-data budget (oversized tensors get their own shard) and writes `model.safetensors.index.json`.
- **Execution**: ran once, succeeded on the first attempt. All required checks (112 bf16, q_proj.0 bf16, embed_tokens fp32, 114 total tensors) and additional round-trip verification (re-reading the written shards and comparing dtypes/values against the source) passed.
- **Output**: `out/T3/` contains 10 shards + index — 2 solo shards for the two 412 MB float32 tensors, and 8 shards of 14 tensors each (exactly 2 layers' worth of bf16 projections, ~256 MiB).
- **Report**: `out/T3/REPORT.md` written with the self-report fields.
